status: User-supplied pin list; compare against the exact motherboard revision and physical socket before manufacturing
cross_check: Rämixx500 (open hardware recreation of A500+ rev. 8A.1) AMIGA_ROM library agrees for numbered pins, but labels pin 30 D15; user labels it D15/A-1. Confirm actual socket wiring and /BYTE mode.

prototype_architecture.banking: For verified 512 KiB x16 ROM images, flash A0-A17 address one image; switch selects flash A18; flash A19 is low in read mode. This yields two 512 KiB banks in the lower 1 MiB, leaving the upper 1 MiB unused. Do not assume the ROM images are 512 KiB until their actual files are checked.
prototype_architecture.read_bus: Five SN74LVC8T245 dual-supply transceivers: three for host-to-flash address and CE#/OE#, two for flash-to-host D0-D15. Flash side VCCA=3.3 V, host side VCCB=host 5 V. Direction and output enables require a reviewed truth table. No host-side buffer may drive while the programmer is active.
prototype_architecture.programming: Detachable 50-way 0.5 mm FFC to a separate USB programmer based provisionally on RP2354B. Program with the Amiga powered off, whether the ROM adapter is installed or removed. External power must feed the adapter's 3.3 V rail without backfeeding the Amiga 5 V rail. An interlock must disable host transceivers and select full A0-A19 plus CE#/OE#/WE#/RST# and D0-D15 from the programmer. Verify by read-back.
prototype_architecture.write_protection: WE# held inactive high in read mode; WP# alone does not protect the entire chip. Only the external programmer may assert WE# after host bus isolation is active.
prototype_architecture.power: 3.3 V regulator candidate TLV75533PDBVR, supplied from an isolated choice of Amiga 5 V or programmer 5 V; power path, regulator thermal limits and decoupling remain to be designed.
